authors.bio: Charles W. Rhodes was born in Buffalo, New York in 1929. He attended the University of California, Berkeley from 1947 to 1950. In 1954 he joined the CBS-Columbia Divison of CBS Broadcasting, as a Field Engineer. From 1956 to 1982 he was employed at Tektronix, most recently as Chief Engineer, TV Products, Communications Division. He holds seven U.S. patents on TV measurement technology and is chairman of EIA, TR 4.4 (Video): a Fellow of SMPTE (1972): and a Fellow of IEEE (1980). In August, 1982 Mr. Rhodes joined Scientific-Atlanta, Inc. as Principal Engineer, Corporate Staff, and reports to Dr. Guy W. Beakley, Vice-President Research and Development.
